newsitem.title: USA: TF Financial Corp Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: TF Financial Corp Q4 net rises.

text.p: NOTE: Net income for the period includes $2.2 million pretax special one time assessment from the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation for the purpose of recapitalizing the Savings Association Insurance Fund.

(A) Per share earnings amounts are based upon the weighted average of fully diluted shares outstanding for the periods of 4.2 million for the three and twelve month periods ended December 31, 1996, and 4.3 million for the three and twelve month periods ended December 31, 1995. Book values shown are based upon the end of period primary shares outstanding of 4.0 and 4.3 million respectively.

(B) All ratios are based on monthly average balances and are annualized where appropriate. Such annualized numbers are not necessarily indicative of results which may be expected for the entire fiscal year or any other period. SOURCE TF Financial Corporation
